title: Deepfakes Circulating and Eroding Electoral Integrity in the Lead-up to 2024 South Korean legislative election

behaviors.text: In the lead-up to Korea's parliamentary elections, at least 129 deepfake videos and images were reported to have been detected, violating new election laws.
These AI-generated deepfakes were used to mislead and manipulate public opinion, prompting a crackdown by the National Election Commission.
